cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import random,time
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
random.seed(42)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
# 5000 random distinct length5
S=set()
while len(S)<5000:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(5)))
paths=[','.join(names[i] for i in t) for t in S]
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)
print('bytes',len(text))
t=time.time();p=parse_policy(text);print('parse',time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
try:
 im=create(text,reg,p);print('compile',time.time()-t,'rows',len(im['rows']))
except Exception as e:print('reject',type(e).__name__,e,'time',time.time()-t)
PY
